title: Funding and support accessible to Malagasy filmmakers
summary: A maintained guide to funds, development programmes, labs and production support that may be accessible to filmmakers and producers from Madagascar.
editorialNote: The earlier Filmada guide is valuable source material, but eligibility, deadlines and programme status change. Entries must be checked against official programme websites before they are shown as current.
